subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-09-30T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Thanks again for the demo this morning - great conversation. As promised, here's a short post-call recap and a few clarifying questions so we can get you an accurate hosted API estimate and a target $/1M-token recommendation.

Recap (what I heard):
- Primary use: product search + short generation for recommendations (server-side).
- Latency target: 200-400ms p95 for most interactive flows.
- Current constraint: budget-conscious; want to understand unit economics at scale before committing to Dedicated.

Questions (to confirm):
1) Expected monthly active requests (or monthly requests): you mentioned ~1M-1.5M monthly requests - can you confirm a target number?
2) Average tokens per request (prompt + response): you estimated ~300-500 tokens - please confirm a tighter average if you can.
3) Peak TPS: you mentioned a steady peak around 100-150 TPS and spikes up to ~250 TPS during campaigns - confirm typical sustained peak and spike behavior.
4) Target $/1M tokens and monthly budget range: is there a target unit cost you have in mind (e.g., $/1M tokens) or a monthly budget range we should aim for?

Attachments: I attached a simple MAP_v1.xlsx that walks through the math if you want to plug in alternate numbers.

Next steps: if you reply with (1) monthly requests, (2) avg tokens/request, and (3) sustained + spike TPS, I'll run a quick unit-economics calc and propose a hosted API estimate and a recommended pilot plan.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Director | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Daniel Park <daniel@shopwise.com>

Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Marissa - thanks for the recap and the attachment. Confirming the numbers from our call and adding a couple details:

1) Monthly requests: targeting ~1.2M requests/month (this is our current forecast for Q4; could be +/- 20%).
2) Average tokens per request: 400 tokens (avg across prompt + response). We have some shorter queries (~150 tokens) and some longer recommendation responses (~800 tokens), but 400 is our working average.
3) Peak TPS: sustained peak ~120 TPS during business hours. We see short promotional spikes up to ~250 TPS for 2-5 minute bursts.
4) Target unit cost / budget: our procurement team is looking for a target between $20-$30 per 1M tokens. Monthly budget we can allocate for hosted API is roughly $10k-$20k initially (pilot + scaling buffer).

We can share more detailed traffic histograms if you need them. Let me know if you want weekly call time to walk through scenarios.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Platform | Shopwise
daniel@shopwise.com | (617) 555-9876

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@shopwise.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Thanks Daniel - super helpful. I ran the numbers quickly based on your inputs and attached a one-page estimate (quote_estimate_Q4.pdf) that shows unit economics and a recommended pilot. Key points below:

Quick math (working assumptions):
- Monthly requests: 1.2M
- Avg tokens/request: 400 tokens
=> Monthly token volume = 1.2M * 400 = 480,000,000 tokens (480M)

Throughput planning:
- Sustained peak: 120 TPS * 400 tokens = 48,000 tokens/sec
- Spike peak: 250 TPS * 400 tokens = 100,000 tokens/sec (2-5 min bursts)
- For the hosted API, we size for sustained peak and advise having autoscale headroom for the short spikes; if spikes are frequent we can discuss Dedicated or burst capacity options.

Cost estimate at your target unit economics:
- At $20 / 1M tokens => 480 * $20 = $9,600 / month
- At $25 / 1M tokens => 480 * $25 = $12,000 / month
- At $30 / 1M tokens => 480 * $30 = $14,400 / month

Recommended next steps (pilot approach):
1) 4-6 week hosted API pilot: start with a smaller subset (10-20% of traffic) to validate latency and cost; collect token histograms and tail latency.
2) If pilot matches targets, move to a 3-month scale plan and discuss a reserved commit (Dedicated) or committed spend discount which can lower $/1M tokens.
3) Optional: we can set up a short live test during one of your promo windows to validate spike behavior (we'll enable burst capacity).

I included a one-page PDF with the same math + recommended pilot milestones. If that looks good, I can get an official quote and a HubSpot deal entry updated (I'll link it to RW-2345).

Would you like to schedule a 30-minute planning call next week to lock pilot cadence? I have availability Tue/Wed afternoon (PDT).

Best,
Marissa
